name: Six Questions Six Hours Six Deaths
source:
A psychological horror visual novel that follows two best friends, Noor and Faiz, who have been given the chance to stay at an exclusive hotel only meant for the elite by participating in a short study. 

What seems to be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity turns to be the complete opposite and instead tests their bond. When you're pushed to the very extreme and can't even tell what's real anymore, would you still be able to trust your friend?

[From [url=https://asja-alexandra.itch.io/six-questions-six-hours-six-deaths]itch.io[/url]]
